question:
So as the title state's, I have a field that has a unix int that I need to convert into a datetime in snowflake (using dbt macros's) - I can do this in SQL easily enough, but am really struggling to get around dbt's escape clauses.

I've tried every possible approach I can find in google, the closest I've come so far is using the {% raw %} tag - which works if I just hard code a value, but I want to be able to use the macro's input parameter:

This works

{%- macro num_to_datetime(datetime_field) -%}
{% raw %}
    DATEADD(MILLISECOND, 1683668421712 % 1000, DATEADD(SECOND, 1683668421712 / 1000, '19700101'))
{% endraw %}
{%- endmacro -%}

This doesn't

{%- macro num_to_datetime(datetime_field) -%}
{% raw %}
    DATEADD(MILLISECOND, {{ datetime_field }} % 1000, DATEADD(SECOND, {{ datetime_field }}/ 1000, '19700101'))
{% endraw %}
{%- endmacro -%}

I've tried using the {% set %} tag to set the input parameter as a variable, but this still, doesn't seem to work (Likely just a syntax issue)

Any help or advice is appreciated (side note: I hate this damned language)

EDIT: Just to add, the use case for doing this in a macro is for automation purposes, we read our metadata in python and generate staging view scripts which parse from json and add business friendly column headers etc. We also use this to apply default macros to certain fields, so that ingesting new source data is as simple as a few clicks the performing a dbt run.
title: Macro to convert a Unix integer into a datetime
answer:
Found a solution, using the snowflake function TO_TIMESTAMP_NTZ()

full macro here for anyone that may want to use it in future:

{%- macro num_to_datetime(epochs, format="milliseconds") -%}
    {%- if format == "seconds" -%}
    {%- set scale = 0 -%}
    {%- elif format == "milliseconds" -%}
    {%- set scale = 3 -%}
    {%- elif format == "microseconds" -%}
    {%- set scale = 6 -%}
    {%- else -%}
    {{ exceptions.raise_compiler_error(
        "value " ~ format ~ " for `format` for from_unixtimestamp is not supported."
        )
    }}
    {% endif -%}
    to_timestamp_ntz({{ epochs }}, {{ scale }})
{%- endmacro %}
